name: import-sources
title: Import sources
description: Where your data can come from: the tools you can import from, what comes across and how long it takes.
docs: Pass sources (an id, the tool's name, an optional mark, what comes across as short names, a time estimate in plain words and the link to its import guide), plus csv for a closing dashed tile and help for the line under the grid. Each tile is one link: the name is a link stretched over the tile, named by the tool and import guide. The chips and the estimate say only what you pass in. A tool without a mark shows its first letter. The block has no state and renders on the server. Words are translated through labels.
